DUNGS Combustion Controls

ATEX-Series

Pressure switches GGW … /2 X

Solenoid valves MV … X

The ATEX pressure switches and solenoid valves were tested and now "Ready fo H2". For this reason the type plates must be adapted.

Until now, these controls were classified in Group 5 with II B, in the future with IIC (Hydrogen).

More information about the marking of ATEX equipment can be found in our ATEX Infographic.

Status UKCA

Online

As previously communicated, by December 31, 2022, DUNGS equipment must be available with UKCA approval, declaration of conformity, and UKCA marking on the type plate.

You can now check the current status online on our website. Here you will find the latest UKCA Status Document. The declarations of conformity will be available by November 30 at the latest.

Please inform your customers.
